questions.question: After showing the prophet Amos a basket of summer fruit, what did the LORD say had come for His people Israel?
In Amos' prophecy, why did the people who trampled the needy want the New Moon and the Sabbath to be over?

answers.text: So they could go to war

questions.question: The LORD swore by the Pride of Jacob that He would someday forget the wrongs of those who cheated the poor. True or false?
Through the prophet Amos, God warned of a coming famine that was not about bread or water. A famine of what?

answers.text: Hearing the words of the LORD
Hearing the songs of the LORD
Hearing the blessings of the LORD
